name: crew-live help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:crew-live (the Crew).
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Open group chat
entries.text: Opens the agent swarm's group chat, where the crew talk about their work.

entries.title: Assign a job
entries.text: Opens the agent swarm, where you hand a job to an agent (Breakroom → Jobs).

entries.title: Open employee card
entries.text: Opens this agent's employee card: who they are, stats, pay, history and write-ups.

entries.title: Their current task
entries.text: Opens the Crew with this agent's current run unfolded: what they are doing now, steps, files and diff.

entries.title: Their history / past runs
entries.text: Opens the agent's profile with their past runs and what each cost.

entries.title: Open in Session browser
entries.text: Opens the agent's current run in the Session browser (when it is installed).

entries.title: Open Terminal tab
entries.text: Opens the agent's live run in a Terminal tab attached to its tmux session.

entries.title: Stop current job
entries.text: Stops the agent's running job after you confirm. Work already committed stays.

entries.title: Terminal tab
entries.text: Opens this run's live Terminal tab (attached to its tmux session on the VPS).

entries.title: Session browser
entries.text: Opens this run in the Session browser: the whole conversation, tool calls and cost.

entries.title: Employee card
entries.text: Opens the agent's employee card: info, stats, pay and history.

entries.title: Stop
entries.text: Stops this run after you confirm: its headless session on the VPS ends. Committed work stays.

entries.title: Off the clock
entries.text: Shows or hides the crew members who aren't working on anything right now.

entries.title: Refresh now
entries.text: Reads the crew again right away (it also updates live by itself).

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Filters the rows by agent, build, step, what they're doing or model.

entries.title: Status
entries.text: Shows every run, or only working, waiting on approval, stuck or idle ones.

entries.title: Crew
entries.text: Every agent working right now, live: what each is doing, their step, time, cost, tokens, files touched and PR. Tap a row for the details and the live diff.
